summary: Methanex Corp. filed a Form 6-K on July 28, 2026, reporting its second-quarter 2026 earnings, including record North American production, net income of $198M, and Adjusted EBITDA of $577M. The filing also announced the indefinite idling of the Titan plant and restructuring activities in Trinidad, with a $115M impairment charge and $12M restructuring accrual. This is a routine earnings report with operational updates, not a special situation event like an acquisition or restructuring filing. No deal terms are present as this is standard quarterly disclosure, not a transaction announcement.
